note: v2505: Walking the river found 12 reels reporting RELEASABLE while frame_authority refused every seal on the tree, which reads exactly like a defect and is not one - reel_retention settled it in v2314, two authorities at two granularities answering different questions, and the attempt to collapse them was withdrawn because it would have stopped the prune firing on every existing reel.
